title: Quickstart: Building Your Open-Source Stack
content:
## The Modern Open-Source Stack in 2026

Building a complete production stack without vendor lock-in is easier than ever. Here is the proven path.

### Hosting Layer
Start with Coolify on a $20/mo Hetzner VPS. It handles SSL, deployments, and monitoring for all your services.

### AI Layer
- Ollama for local model inference
- Open WebUI for team AI chat
- Qdrant for vector search

### Automation Layer
n8n handles 80% of integration needs visually. Add custom Python microservices for the remaining 20%.
seoDescription: Build your complete open-source tech stack in 2026. AI, automation, hosting, and search covered.
